investment_signals.headline: Spotify reported 300 million Premium subscribers and 777 million MAUs in Q2 2026.
investment_signals.detail: Q2 2026 Premium subscribers were 300M, up 9% year over year, while MAUs were 777M, up 12%. Revenue was €4,777M, gross margin 33.4%, operating income €655M and free cash flow €797M.
investment_signals.metric_name: Premium subscribers; MAUs; revenue; gross margin; operating income; free cash flow

investment_signals.headline: Spotify added 7 million net Premium subscribers in Q2 2026 and Premium revenue grew 15%.
investment_signals.detail: The shareholder deck reported 7M net Premium adds, 494M ad-supported MAUs, Premium revenue of €4,331M, and Premium ARPU of €4.89, up 7% year over year. Ad-supported revenue grew 1% year over year, or 3% in constant currency.
investment_signals.metric_name: Net Premium adds; Premium revenue; Premium ARPU

investment_signals.headline: Spotify guided to 305 million Premium subscribers and €5.0 billion revenue for Q3 2026.
investment_signals.detail: Q3 guidance was 305M Premium subscribers, 788M MAUs, €5.0B revenue, 32.9% gross margin and €670M operating income. The deck also showed €9M of expected social charges.
investment_signals.metric_name: Q3 Premium subscribers; MAUs; revenue; gross margin; operating income

investment_signals.headline: Spotify announced a select-market Premium Individual price increase from €10.99 to €11.99.
investment_signals.detail: Reuters reported the increase in selected markets across South Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific, with implementation from September 2025. Spotify said subscribers would receive an email explaining the change.

investment_signals.headline: Spotify raised US Premium Individual, Duo and Family prices.
investment_signals.detail: Reuters reported Individual rising from $10.99 to $11.99, Duo from $14.99 to $16.99 and Family from $16.99 to $19.99. Spotify shares rose more than 4% in morning trading after the announcement.

investment_signals.headline: Spotify management described the business as healthy and compounding while emphasizing product investment.
investment_signals.detail: Co-President and Chief Business Officer Alex Norstrom described Spotify as a healthy and compounding business with opportunities it is positioned to pursue. Gustav Söderström said Spotify was building new products and ways for users to engage while maintaining a high bar for investment.

consumer_reaction.price_sentiment_summary: The visible review example praised Spotify utility but complained about price increases and too many ads; the same review also described playback stopping when leaving the app. This is one visible review, not a measurable share of reviews.

derived_metrics.notes: Computed from current GB localized pages retrieved 2026-09-28; GBP/USD cross-rate is calculated from the two ECB reference rates.

key_findings: Spotify current official Individual prices span $12.99 in the US, £12.99 in GB, €12.14 in France, €13.99 in Belgium/Netherlands, ₹139 Standard in India and R$23.90 in Brazil; each value is dated 2026-09-28 and linked in pricing_baseline.

Spotify’s Q2 2026 operating snapshot shows 300M Premium subscribers (+9% YoY), 777M MAUs (+12%), 33.4% gross margin, €655M operating income and €797M free cash flow (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).

Q2 2026 Premium ARPU was €4.89, up 7% YoY, while Premium revenue was €4,331M, up 15%; ad-supported revenue grew 1% (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).

The latest sourced regional price move was the September 2025 select-market Individual increase from €10.99 to €11.99 (+9.1%) (https://www.reuters.com/business/spotify-raise-premium-subscription-price-select-markets-september-2025-08-04/).

The US June 2024 move raised Individual 9.1%, Duo 13.3% and Family 17.7%; Reuters reported Spotify shares rose more than 4% that morning (https://www.reuters.com/technology/spotify-raise-price-premium-individual-plan-2024-06-03/).

In the only country with a complete three-way comparison and sourced FX conversion, GB Spotify Individual is about 8.3% above Apple Music and at parity with YouTube Premium on the computed USD basis; this is a derived comparison, not a source-stated price premium.

The current source set does not establish any competitor price response after Spotify’s hikes and does not provide consumer reaction coverage across the requested countries; those remain material monitoring gaps.
analyst_summary.hike_pattern: The sourced history shows a US multi-tier hike announced 2024-06-03, an approximately $1/$2 international plan move reported 2024-04-03 without exact local prices, a France tax-related increase announced 2024-03-07 without a stated amount, and a broad select-market Individual move announced 2025-08-04 from €10.99 to €11.99 for September 2025. Country-level effective dates are not stated in the captured sources, so cadence and first-mover geography cannot be established beyond these dated announcements (https://www.reuters.com/technology/spotify-raise-price-premium-individual-plan-2024-06-03/; https://www.reuters.com/business/spotify-raise-premium-subscription-price-select-markets-september-2025-08-04/).
bull_points: Premium subscriber growth and ARPU growth coexisted in Q2 2026: 300M Premium subscribers (+9% YoY) and €4.89 Premium ARPU (+7% YoY) (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).
Q2 2026 gross margin was 33.4%, operating income €655M and free cash flow €797M (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).
Management characterized Spotify as a healthy and compounding business while continuing product investment (https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-08-04/spotify-q2-2026-earnings/).
bear_points: Q3 guidance called for gross margin of 32.9%, below Q2’s 33.4%, with €670M operating income despite higher guided revenue (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).

Ad-supported revenue grew only 1% YoY in Q2 2026, or 3% in constant currency, versus 15% Premium-revenue growth (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).

A visible US Google Play review complained about price increases and too many ads, but the source is a single review and cannot quantify churn or backlash (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music&hl=en_US).

run_schedule.weekly_production_schedule: Run once daily at 13:00 UTC; publish a dated JSON snapshot and diff against baseline_date 2026-09-25, with an extra re-run within 24 hours of any official pricing announcement.

implementation_notes: Use exact localized URL and country code; never substitute a generic US-dollar page.
Capture recurring price separately from trial or prepaid pricing; preserve the verbatim trial text.
Record tax-inclusive only when the page explicitly states it; otherwise use not stated.
Do not infer missing tiers or country prices; add a precise gap and leave the row out.
For daily runs, diff today’s rows against the 2026-09-25 baseline and flag additions, deletions, price changes, trial changes and tier-name changes.
For history, keep announced_date and effective_date distinct and use unknown when the source does not give an exact date.
Only compute derived metrics when Spotify, Apple and YouTube Individual prices and a dated FX source are all present for the same country.
